title: Fetal Brain Tissue Dissociation Protocol for Single-Cell RNA Sequencing
author: Siddharth Singh
materials: Do not pipette up and down.
If visible micro-aggregates remain after the first cleanup:

Ship or transfer on dry ice.

steps.title: Collect and pool fetal brain tissue
steps.instruction: Collect fetal brains rapidly into ice‑cold HBSS without Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺, keep tissue cold, minimize time before enzyme exposure, pool to ≈100 mg per sample/group if needed, remove obvious blood and gross non‑neural debris, and proceed immediately to reagent loading.

steps.title: Reconstitute enzymes
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL Buffer X to the lyophilized Enzyme T, close the vial and invert gently to mix; add 1 mL sterile water to the lyophilized Enzyme A, then mix both reconstituted enzymes by gentle inversion before aliquoting or use.

steps.title: Prepare enzyme mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare Enzyme mix 1 by combining 60 µL Enzyme T with 1 890 µL Buffer X (total 1 950 µL). Prepare Enzyme mix 2 by combining 20 µL Buffer Y with 10 µL Enzyme A. Use the full standard mixes even though tissue mass is <400 mg.

steps.title: Load enzyme mix into C Tube and pre‑heat
steps.instruction: Add 1 950 µL Enzyme mix 1 to a gentleMACS C Tube, then pre‑heat the tube at 37 °C for 10–15 min.

steps.title: Add tissue and mount C Tube
steps.instruction: Transfer ~200 mg fetal brain tissue into the pre‑heated C Tube, close the tube tightly, mount it upside‑down on the gentleMACS Dissociator sleeve, and ensure the tissue is positioned in the rotator/stator area.

steps.title: First dissociation incubation
steps.instruction: Run the program m_brain_01, then incubate the tube for 15 min at 37 °C under slow continuous rotation on the MACSmix Tube Rotator.

steps.title: Second dissociation with Enzyme mix 2
steps.instruction: Run program m_brain_02, add 30 µL Enzyme mix 2 to the C Tube, and incubate for 10 min at 37 °C under slow continuous rotation.

steps.title: Third dissociation and brief spin
steps.instruction: Run program m_brain_03, incubate another 10 min at 37 °C under slow continuous rotation, then remove the tube and centrifuge briefly to collect the digest at the bottom. Keep the tube rotating as instructed; if yield is low, gently flick or invert between incubations.

steps.title: Settle debris and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Resuspend the digest gently after the brief spin; if flocculent debris or tissue fragments are visible, let the suspension settle undisturbed for 30–60 s, then transfer the clearer supernatant to a clean tube, leaving the heaviest debris behind.

steps.title: Filter through 70 µm strainer and wash
steps.instruction: Apply the supernatant to a pre‑wet 70 µm SmartStrainer placed in a 50 mL tube, then wash the strainer with 10 mL HBSS containing Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend cell pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate at 300 × g for 10 min at room temperature, then gently resuspend the pellet in an appropriate volume of cold buffer.

steps.title: Optional 30 µm filtration before counting
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 30 µm strainer immediately before cell counting; use this step only when removal of aggregates is more important than maximal recovery of larger cells.

steps.title: Assess viability and quality
steps.instruction: Confirm the suspension contains minimal clumps and tissue fragments; target >80 % viability (ideally >90 %). For samples with substantial debris, use fluorescence‑based viability counting or manual hemocytometer confirmation rather than trypan blue alone. For fixed cells, nuclei, or high‑debris suspensions, fluorescent viability dyes are strongly recommended.

steps.title: Optional additional enzymatic digestion
steps.instruction: If the suspension is clearly under‑dissociated, either (A) add 30 µL Enzyme mix 2 per mL of cell suspension, mix gently and incubate (duration as needed), or (B) add 30 µL Enzyme mix 2 per 2 mL, then incubate 5–10 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Fix cells with methanol
steps.instruction: Begin fixation only after a homogeneous single‑cell suspension is obtained. Transfer cells into a Falcon tube containing 5–10 mL cold PBS, centrifuge at 500 g, 4 °C for 5 min, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL cold 1X PBS, tap gently and place the tube on ice. Add methanol dropwise while vortexing slowly to form a PBS:methanol suspension, incubate on ice for 20 min with occasional tapping.

steps.title: Aliquot, store, and record metadata
steps.instruction: Aliquot the fixed suspension into 1.5 mL tubes (≈1 mL per tube), store at –80 °C, and transport on dry ice. Record sample ID, tissue source, pooled mass, digestion date, operator, kit lot, and estimated cell concentration before fixation.
